title: Corrected exact evidence indexing with explicit build/query cost boundaries
question: Can an exact prefix evidence histogram preserve the G-CASM-015 activation-trace selector while removing the O(M) candidate scan from repeated one-step selection queries?
hypothesis: An exact prefix histogram built once from public candidate-predicted activation traces should reproduce exhaustive action choice and information scores exactly, while its repeated query work is bounded by the fixed activation-trace alphabet rather than the candidate population M.

arms.name: trace_exhaustive
arms.intervention: G-CASM-015 activation-trace selector scans all M cached candidates for every legal input-row action

arms.name: trace_indexed
arms.intervention: exact prefix histogram lookup reads precomputed per-action evidence counts and cumulative costs without scanning candidate records

endpoints.name: primary_query_latency_advantage_m512
endpoints.role: primary — paired seed difference in measured selector query latency at M=512

endpoints.name: selector_exact_action_agreement
endpoints.role: secondary — exact action equality across all registered seed/M/task cells

endpoints.name: information_score_agreement
endpoints.role: secondary — exact information gain, expected residual candidates and expected environment cost agreement

endpoints.name: query_complexity_descriptor
endpoints.role: secondary — exhaustive candidate-record reads versus indexed histogram-bin reads

endpoints.name: loglog_query_slope
endpoints.role: secondary — per-seed measured query-time scaling across M levels

endpoints.name: one_time_index_build
endpoints.role: secondary — explicit one-time construction work per static candidate library

held_constant: same G-CASM-015 activation-trace channel and pinned generator commit
same 512-program static evaluation library per seed
same 32 query tasks per seed and M
same train/evaluation structure and truth disjointness gates
same exhaustive selector scoring rule and deterministic tie-break order
index is built once from public candidate-side evidence and reused for all registered queries per seed
exactness_requirements: indexed selected action must equal exhaustive selected action
indexed information gain must equal exhaustive information gain within 1e-12
indexed expected remaining candidates must equal exhaustive value within 1e-12
indexed expected environment cost must equal exhaustive value within 1e-12
target evidence is never accessed before selector choice

cost_model.exhaustive_query: candidate records read for 16 actions: 16*M; expected cost is obtained from the same cached records
cost_model.indexed_build: one-time construction from the 512-candidate cache; explicit candidate-record reads are 16*512
cost_model.indexed_query: reads one cumulative histogram series per non-empty evidence signature per action; maximum is 16*2^TRACE_WIDTH and is independent of M for fixed trace width
cost_model.wall_clock_query: median CPU latency measured on the same GitHub Actions runner for both arms after warm-up; hardware-dependent and reported as such
cost_model.amortized_lifecycle: index_build wall-clock plus registered query workload wall-clock, reported separately from query-only latency

primary_endpoint.seed_aggregation: mean query latency across deterministic repeats within each seed, then paired trace_exhaustive minus trace_indexed across five seeds

decision_rule.condition: indexed selector is exact-equivalent and the seed-bootstrap 95% interval for exhaustive_minus_indexed query latency at M=512 is entirely positive
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that exact candidate-side indexing reduces repeated selector-query latency on the pinned CI workload while preserving selector behavior
decision_rule.does_not_license: sublinear total history acquisition, asymptotic hardware-independent speedup, learned probing, or general intelligence.

decision_rule.condition: indexed selector is exact-equivalent but the latency interval includes zero
decision_rule.licenses: exact indexing preserves the selector but does not establish a reliable latency advantage on the pinned workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: failure of all exact indexing schemes.

decision_rule.licenses: implementation invalid; no efficiency result is admitted
decision_rule.does_not_license: any scientific efficiency claim from the run.

leakage_rules: the index uses only candidate-predicted activation traces and candidate execution costs already present in the public cache
target identity, target index, realized target evidence and verifier labels never affect index construction or query scoring
no result from 017A or 017B is used to select M, evidence width, or timing parameters
the index is not tuned against test outcomes

provenance.parent_failure: non-commensurate work units and hidden O(M) expected-cost scan in indexed query
